buyer: Oslo kommune v/ Boligbygg Oslo KF
title: Anskaffelse av internrevisjonstjenester
description: Boligbygg Oslo KF (heretter BBY) har til formål å inngå kontrakt om internrevisjonstjenester for å oppnå sine målsettinger ved å benytte en systematisk og strukturert metode for å evalurere og forbedre effektiviteten og hensiktsmessigheten avorganisasjonens prosesser for risikostyring, styring og kontroll og governance.

title: Rammeavtale – Risikovurderinger for Sjøfartsdirektoratet
description: Sjøfartsdirektoratet har behov for å inngå en rammeavtale om konsulentbistand innen risikoanalyse og andre sikkerhetsfaglige problemstillinger. Avtalen skal gi oss tilgang til kapasitet og/eller spisskompetanse, samt uavhengige fagvurderinger hvis en sak krever det. Bistanden skal støtte direktoratets arbeid med sjøsikkerhet, miljø og beredskap. Oppdragene vil blant annet handle om å kartlegge næringens arbeid innenfor risikostyring, sikkerhet og sikring. Herunder undersøke hvorvidt vurderinger er gjort i henhold til regelverk, anerkjent praksis og fastsatte mål. Oppdragene kan også gjelde myndighetenes egen risikostyring, blant annet metodeutvikling og videreutvikling av direktoratets analysearbeid i lys av ny kunnskap og teknologi. Enkelte oppdrag vil være mer undersøkende — å klarlegge status på et fagfelt, kunnskapsgrunnlaget på et område, eller risikobildet for en bestemt fartøygruppe eller aktivitet. Tildeling av kontrakter under rammeavtalen vil kunne variere fra år til år avhengig av bevilgninger og hvorvidt Sjøfartsdirektoratet også vil koordinere andre etaters prosjektmidler innenfor området. Sjøfartsdirektoratet kan derfor ikke gi noen garantier for omsetning i avtaleperioden for rammeavtalen

title: Opera Østfold // CARMEN // Teknikk og scenografi m.v. utstyr og personell (nytt)
description: Opera Østfold skal gjennomføre en utendørsoppsetning av Georges Bizets Carmen på Fredriksten festning i juni 2027. Det skal inngås avtale med én hovedleverandør for tekniske leveranser og scenografi til produksjonen. Leveransen skal planlegges og gjennomføres i tett samarbeid med Opera Østfolds produsent, tekniske produsent og scenograf.

title: Vikartjenester til helse, oppvekst og barnevern i Løten kommune
description: Løten kommune har behov for avtale om bemanningstjenester innenfor helse og oppvekst, inkludert barneverntjenesten. Kommunen har til hensikt å inngå en parallell rammeavtale for å sikre god tilgang på egnet personell. Oppdrag under rammeavtalen vil tildeles den leverandøren som besvarer henvendelsen raskest, og som kan stille med egnet kompetanse for oppdraget.

title: Rammeavtale - slipptjenester og vedlikehold av båter
description: Oslobygg KF har tre båter i sin portefølje, og båtene benyttes av Osloskolen. Disse båtene har et vedvarende behov for lagring og vedlikehold, og dette er kompetanse og ressurser foretaket selv ikke besitter. Av den grunn er det nødvendig å tilknytte seg en leverandør som ivaretar dette behovet. Rammeavtalen omfatter slipptjenester og vedlikehold av Osloskolens båter. Skrogvedlikehold kan være aktuelt i rammeavtalen. Avtalen vil også omfatte sertifiseringer og godkjenning av utstyr og båter.

title: Utblokking vannledning - Valhallveien
description: Ringerike kommune innbyr til konkurranse iht. forsyningsforskriftens del 1 for prosjekt «Valhallveien – rehabilitering av vannledning». Formålet med konkurransen er å anskaffe entreprenør for gjennomføring av rehabilitering av hovedvannledning og overvannsledning uten graving i Valhallveien i Heradsbygda.

title: Skybasert sak- og arkivsystem til Arbeidstilsynet (2. utlysning)
description: Oppdragsgiver skal gjennomføre en konkurranse om anskaffelse av en løpende avtale for kjøp av skybasert sak- og arkivsystem. I dag benyttes Elements som sak- arkivsystem, med modulene sak-arkiv, møte og byggesak. Dette er en løsning som driftes på egne lokale servere og som ikke er en skytjeneste Arbeidstilsynet ønsker en skybasert (SaaS) saks- og arkivløsning som: • støtter effektiv saksbehandling og tilsynsarbeid • legger til rette for standardisert og god informasjonsforvaltning • har moderne brukergrensesnitt og høy brukervennlighet • muliggjør automatisering og effektivisering Ny utlysing av konkurranse Denne konkurransen har tidligere vært avlyst grunnet behov for å gjøre en endring i kravspesifikasjonen, og dette er 2. utlysning. Konkurransedokumentene i de to utlysningene er tilsvarende med unntak av endringene nedenfor. • I forrige utlysing inneholdt SSA-L Bilag 1 følgende formulering i krav nr. 73 og 74: Krav nr. 73: «Tilbudt løsning skal leveres av leverandør med konsesjon fra Direktoratet for byggkvalitet (DiBK).» Krav nr. 74: «Tilbudt løsning skal motta digitale søknader via plattformen Fellestjenester bygg (FtB).» Ovennevnte krav er fjernet og erstattet med følgende krav i ny utlysing: «Leverandøren av systemet må ha nødvendig godkjenning fra DiBK ved kontraktsoppstart. Godkjenningen skal dokumentere at systemet støtter nasjonale sjekklister, import av søknadsdata fra FtPB og tilbakemeldinger via FtPB til søknadssystem.» • Konkurransens fremdriftsplan er oppdatert, jf. Regler for anskaffelsen, punkt 1.8.

title: Næringsmidler
description: Bakgrunn Utover bestemmelsene i konkurransegrunnlaget og informasjon i KGV (Hyyr) vises det til vedlegg konkurransebestemmelser. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å inngå rammeavtaler som bidrar til at Innlandet fylkeskommune (IFK) kan oppnå mat- og måltidsservering av fullverdige, sunne og rimelige måltider med lavt miljø- og klimaavtrykk og en tydelig lokal tilhørighet, jf. Innlandets Matløfte som IFK signerte i 2025. Frokost og lunsj som oppfyller tallerkenmodellen, oppsummerer hvordan fullverdige måltider settes sammen for et helsefremmende og miljøvennlig matforbruk. Vann og melk er anbefalt drikke. I kantinene, som er den største innkjøperen på avtalen, er målet at de sunne alternativene og måltidene skal være rimeligst og lettest tilgjengelig. Dette innebærer blant annet å fremme et høyt innkjøp av korn og grove kornvarer, poteter, grønnsaker, frukt, bær, belgvekster, frø og nøtter, fisk og sjømat, samt sertifiserte mat- og drikkevarer (herunder økologisk, MSC/ASC og Fairtrade der det er relevant). Det skal også tilrettelegges for økt bruk av varer produsert i Innlandet og Norge. Samtidig skal anskaffelsen dekke behovet for råvarer innen alle matvaregrupper, slik at undervisningen i restaurant- og matfag kan gjennomføres på en faglig god måte. Bærekraft, folkehelse, demokratiforståelse og livsmestring er tverrfaglige temaer som skal gjennomsyre opplæringen i fylkeskommunens skoler. Rammeavtalene for næringsmidler skal bidra til å understøtte oppdragsgivers målsettinger innenfor disse områdene. Oppdragsgiver ønsker å inngå avtaler med leverandører som tilbyr høy kvalitet, god service og relevant kompetanse, og som aktivt bidrar til ønsket forbruks- og bestillingsmønster. Dette inkluderer gode digitale løsninger, tydelig produktinformasjon og merkeordninger, samt tilbud om kurs, veiledning og statistikk som kan støtte opp under informerte valg hos bestillere og brukere. Gjennom konkurransen ønsker IFK at leverandørene kan vise hvordan deres tilbud av vareutvalg og priser, nettbutikk, merkeordninger/informasjon, kampanjer, salgsfremmende tiltak, kurs og/eller forbruksstatistikk kan bidra til å fremme ønsket forbruks- og bestillingsmønster. Anskaffelsen skal samtidig bidra til å begrense forbruket av varer med lav ernæringsmessig verdi, som godteri, snacks, søte drikkevarer og lignende produkter. Oppdragsgiver benytter Hyyr-portalen. Her kunngjøres konkurransen, konkurransedokumentene legges ut, kommunikasjon foregår og tilleggsinformasjon legges ut. For at du som tilbyder skal få del i kommunikasjonen og tilleggsinformasjonen som legges ut, er det avgjørende at du har meldt interesse for konkurransen i Hyyr. De virksomhetene/lokasjonene som er omfattet av denne avtalen, er listet i vedlegg konkurransebestemmelser. I tillegg til fylkeskommunens virksomheter omfatter anskaffelsen følgende virksomheter: A/S Kirkegaten 74 v/kantina Postboks 153 2626 Lillehammer Org.nr.: 930 635 944 Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget gjelder levering av næringsmidler til Innlandet fylkeskommune og øvrige deltakende virksomheter i avtaleperioden. Rammeavtalen skal legge til rette for at oppdragsgiver kan prioritere varer som bygger opp under sunne måltider, bærekraftige innkjøp og ønsket dreining i forbruket. Det er også viktig at leveransen støtter behovet for kvalitet, leveringssikkerhet og praktisk gjennomførbarhet. Anskaffelsen har et betydelig omfang og skal dekke oppdragsgivers samlede behov innen avtaleområdet Avtaleperiode Rammeavtalene har en varighet på 2 år. Oppdragsgiver har en ensidig rett til å forlenge avtalen med ytterligere 1 + 1 år. Dersom oppdragsgiver beslutter at avtalen ikke skal forlenges, skal oppdragsgiver gi skriftlig melding til leverandøren senest 3 måneder før avtaleperiodens utløp. Dersom maksimalt uttak (se vedlagte avtaleforslag) nås før avtaleperiodens utløp, forbeholder oppdragsgiver seg retten til å avslutte avtalen, uavhengig av avtalens løpetid. Konkurransens verdi Konkurransen er delt inn i syv delkontrakter. Estimert maksimal verdi for rammeavtalene er beregnet som summen av de enkelte delkontraktenes maksimalverdier: Del 1 «Kolonialvarer»: kr 88 715 000 Del 2 «Bær, frukt og grønnsaker»: kr 22 880 000 Del 3 «Meieriprodukter»: kr 45 760 000 Del 4 «Kjøttprodukter»: kr 17 160 000 Del 5 «Fugl, fjærkre og egg»: kr 8 580 000 Del 6 «Mineralvann og drikke»: kr 5 750 000 Del 7 «Fisk og sjømat»: kr 6 000 000 Samlet maksimal verdi for konkurransen og de tilhørende rammeavtalene er kr 194 845 000 ekskl. mva. Verdianslaget er basert på summen av maksimalverdiene for de enkelte delkontraktene. Oppgitt volum representerer estimert årlig omsetning og er basert på tidligere erfaringstall. Tallene er kun veiledende og medfører ingen kjøpsplikt for oppdragsgiver. Endringer i teknologi, organisering, budsjett og rutiner kan påvirke totalvolumet. Politiske føringer innen næringsmidler kan påvirke forbruksmønsteret i avtaleperioden, for eksempel knyttet til temaer som miljø, folkehelse, beredskap og regional produksjon. Dette kan blant annet skje gjennom oppfølging av Innlandets Matløfte, nye nasjonalfaglige retningslinjer fra Helsedirektoratet om mat og måltider i videregående skole eller andre føringer.

title: 26211 (2026-125) Leker og formingsmateriell, rammeavtale
description: Konkurransen gjelder rammeavtale på levering av leker og formingsmateriell. Deltagere i anskaffelsen er kommunene Eidsvoll, Gjerdrum, Hurdal, Nannestad, Nes og Ullensaker. Anskaffelsens verdi anslås til: NOK 3.000.000,- eks. mva per år. Maksimalverdi for hele avtaleperioden, inkludert eventuelle opsjoner og forventet prisstigning: NOK 15.000.000,- eks mva. Behovet er usikkert. Volumet kan variere både opp og ned, og vil i avtaleperioden være avhengig av blant annet oppdragsgivers behov, aktiviteter, budsjettsituasjon og andre rammefaktorer. For nærmere informasjon viser vi til anskaffelsesdokumentene. Lærlinger: Oppdragsgiver har vurdert anskaffelsen opp mot anskaffelsesloven § 5h, og konkludert med at det ikke stilles krav til lærlinger i denne anskaffelsen da anskaffelsen er en vareanskaffelse, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5h 1. ledd.

title: Sandbukta vannbehandlingsanlegg (VBA), Heim kommune - Maskintekniske installasjoner
description: Bakgrunn og formål A. PROSJEKTINFORMASJON A.1 Tilbudsinnbydelse Heim kommune innbyr herved til å gi tilbud på: Entreprise E1: Komplett leveranse og montering av prosessteknisk utstyr ved Sandbukta vannbehandlingsanlegg. Entreprise E1 er organisert som en totalentreprise og entreprenøren skal gi funksjons- og prosessgaranti for tilbudt anlegg. Dette dokument, med de bestemmelser, beskrivelsen og tegninger som det er henvist til, gir rammen for tilbudet og viser hvilke funksjons- og kvalitetskrav som må være tilfredsstilt. Tilbyder må selv sørge for nødvendig arbeidsgrunnlag herunder tegninger, beregninger, FDV dokumentasjon etc. Alle henvendelser angående tilbudet stilles via Hyyr. Det henvises til vedlagt Konkurransegrunnlag for ytterligere informasjon.

description: Follo Ren IKS skal inngå avtale om operasjonell leasing av 1 stk. gravemaskin (ca. 16 tonn).

description: Det skal anskaffes avtale om avfallshåndtering for eiendommer i Volda. Avtalen skal omfatte leie av beholdere, transport og sluttbehandling av avfall.

title: Reisesikkerhetstjenester
description: Formålet med anskaffelsen er å inngå avtale med én leverandør som kan levere helhetlige reisesikkerhets- og Travel Risk Management-tjenester til Innovasjon Norge. Leveransen skal bidra til at Oppdragsgiver kan ivareta arbeidsgiveransvar og omsorgsplikt overfor ansatte på tjenestereise og ved utenlandsopphold, og gi ansatte og relevante funksjoner tilgang til oppdatert risikoinformasjon, varsling og profesjonell bistand ved medisinske og sikkerhetsrelaterte hendelser. Løsningen skal inngå som en del av Innovasjon Norges samlede styring av reiserisiko, men erstatter ikke Oppdragsgivers egne beslutninger, risikovurderinger, beredskapsplaner eller ansvarslinjer.

description: Betreft een architectenselectie, zie selectieleidraad.

title: Netherlands – Accounting, auditing and fiscal services – Accountantsdienstverlening
description: Het STC maakt op dit moment gebruik van een externe accountant voor de wettelijke controle van de jaarrekening, interim-controle en aanvullende assurance werkzaamheden. De huidige accountant voldoet aan de beroepsnormen, beschikt over relevante ervaring in de onderwijssector en draagt bij aan een stabiele en betrouwbare controlecyclus. De huidige overeenkomst loopt af, waardoor een nieuwe aanbesteding nodig is om de continuïteit van de controlefunctie te waarborgen. De werkzaamheden omvatten onder meer de controle van de jaarrekening, het beoordelen van interne beheersingsprocessen, het uitvoeren van specifieke opdrachten (zoals subsidie verklaringen) en het leveren van advies binnen de kaders van onafhankelijkheid. STC organiseert voor potentiële inschrijvers op 1 oktober een inzagemoment voor documenten die vanwege hun vertrouwelijke aard niet via TenderNed openbaar worden gemaakt. Meld u uiterlijk 28 september 12:00 uur aan indien u wenst deel te nemen. In de afgelopen jaren bedroegen de gemiddelde jaarlijkse uitgaven voor de gevraagde dienstverlening (onderdelen A tot en met F), inclusief aanvullende projectverklaringen (onderdeel G), circa € 230.000 exclusief btw. Historisch gezien laat STC gemiddeld vijf tot zes projectverklaringen per jaar uitvoeren. Aan deze gegevens kunnen geen rechten of afnamegaranties worden ontleend.

title: Netherlands – Recruitment services – Werving & Selectie management- en strategische (ondersteunende) functies
description: De aanbestedende dienst wenst de werving en selectie van management- en strategische functies (schalen 11 t/m 15) en van strategisch ondersteunende rollen extern te beleggen, gericht op structurele indiensttreding en dus nadrukkelijk niet op inhuur via een detacherings- of flexconstructie. Met deze aanbesteding beoogt de Opdrachtgever één deskundige partij te contracteren die het volledige werving- en selectieproces zorgvuldig, consistent en ontzorgend uitvoert, waarbij de opdrachtnemer verantwoordelijk is voor onder meer de vacatureteksten, externe publicatie, netwerkinzet en (voor)selectie inclusief screening en assessments, en de Opdrachtgever zorg draagt voor de inhoudelijke input, de gesprekken en de onboarding. Omvang van de opdracht bedraagt €900.000 gedurende de gehele looptijd van de opdracht inclusief verlengingen

title: Netherlands – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Logistieke applicatie oplossing
description: Het CBR wil met deze aanbesteding een complete Logistieke applicatie oplossing aanschaffen. Deze oplossing bestaat uit een in het CBR-landschap On Premise geïmplementeerde en operationeel geaccepteerde applicatie plus de verder bij de aangeboden oplossing horende componenten (bijvoorbeeld ID-scanners, aanmeldstations, ticketprinters e.d.). De geraamde waarde van de Overeenkomst bedraagt €1.221.340 exclusief btw. Dit bedrag is inclusief alle opties tot verlenging en uitbreiding.

title: Netherlands – Engineering works and construction works – Herinrichting Overdie-West, gemeente Alkmaar
description: De wijk Overdie-West in de gemeente Alkmaar staat voor een integrale herinrichting. De huidige riolering en een groot deel van de openbare ruimte hebben het einde van hun technische levensduur bereikt en worden vervangen. Het werk bestaat in hoofdzaak uit: - het schonen van het terrein; - het verwijderen en aanbrengen van riolering, huisaansluitingen, inspectieputten, kolken en kolkaansluitingen; - het verwijderen en aanbrengen van elementenverhardingen, kantlagen, molgoten en kantopsluitingen; - het zagen en opbreken van asfaltverhardingen; - het uitvoeren van grondwerk, waaronder het ontgraven, vervoeren en verwerken van grond; - het toepassen van bemaling; - het leveren en aanbrengen van funderingsmateriaal; - het verwijderen en aanbrengen van bebording en wegmeubilair; - het leveren, aanbrengen en verplaatsen van openbare verlichting; - het toepassen van verkeersmaatregelen; - het uitvoeren van bijkomende werkzaamheden. Voor meer informatie verwijzen we u graag naar het bestek. Zie aanbestedingsdocumenten.

title: Netherlands – Refuse disposal and treatment – EA Afvaldienstverlening
description: De kern van de aanbesteding betreft het aangaan van een samenwerking waarin enerzijds een actieve begeleiding wordt gefaciliteerd in het behalen van interne (duurzaamheids-)doelstellingen op het gebied van afvaldienstverlening (zie Beschrijvend document par. 1.10) en anderzijds het uitvoeren van de standaarddiensten omtrent afvalverwerking. Dit houdt in het leveren en wisselen van containers met een vastgestelde frequentie voor de afvalstromen restafval, papier/karton en vertrouwelijk papier. Ook het reinigen van containers valt binnen de scope van de opdracht. De geraamde opdrachtwaarde is €600.000,- gebaseerd op de maximale looptijd van de Overeenkomst van zes (6) jaar. Zie Beschrijvend document par. 2.4.

title: Denmark – Refuse transport services – Transport af containere mellem genbrugspladser og modtageanlæg
description: Opgaven omfatter afhentning og transport af bestilte tømninger af affald og genanvendelige materialer i containere og mobilkomprimatorer fra 8 genbrugspladser i Sønderborg Kommune. Transporten er til navngivne modtageanlæg med tilhørende returkørsel med tomt udstyr.

title: Netherlands – Fire insurance services – Brandverzekering gemeente Dantumadiel
description: Het doel van de Aanbestedingsprocedure is het sluiten van de Overeenkomst met één of meerdere Opdrachtnemer(s) voor een uitgebreide gevarenverzekering ten behoeve van de eigendommen van gemeente dantumadiel. title: Norway – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Cloud based case and archive system for the Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority (2nd notice).
description: The contracting authority shall hold a competition for the procurement of a continual contract for the procurement of a cloud based case and archive system. Elements is currently used as a case-archive system, with the modules case-archive, meeting and building matters. This is a system that is operated on separate local servers and is not a cloud service. The Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority requests a cloud based (SaaS) case and archive system such as: • supports effective case handling and supervision work • facilitate standardised and good information management. • have a modern user interface and high user friendliness enabling automation and streamlining New competition notice This tender contest has previously been cancelled due to the need to make a change in the requirement specifications and this is the second notice. The competition documents in the two notices are equivalent, with the exception of the amendments below. • In the previous notice, the SSA-L Annex 1 contained the following formulation in requirement nos. 73 and 74: Requirement no. 73: "The offered system shall be delivered by a tenderer with a licence from the Agency for Building Quality (DiBK)." Requirement no. 74: The offered system shall receive digital applications via the platform Fellestjenester bygg (FtB)." The above mentioned requirements have been removed and replaced with the following requirements in the new announcement: "The tenderer of the system must have the necessary certification from DiBK when the contract is initiated. The certification shall document that the system supports national check-lists, import of application data from FtPB and feedback via FtPB to the application system." • The competition ́s progress plan has been updated, cf. Rules for the procurement, point 1.8.

title: Netherlands – Security services – Tijdelijke Beveiliging door Mobiele Camera Units
description: Deze aanbesteding betreft de tijdelijke beveiliging door het huren van Mobiele Camera Units, hierna: MCU's, op hoogspanningsstations en opslaglocaties. De scope van deze aanbesteding betreft het gepland en ongepland leveren en plaatsen (inclusief aarden) van MCU's, het beheren (preventief en correctief onderhoud) en de alarmopvolging binnen TenneT TSO. Middels deze aanbesteding dienen verstoringen en (mogelijke) inbraken op de hoogspannings- en opslaglocaties gesignaleerd te worden waarbij technische verificatie mogelijk is door de Particuliere Alarm Centrale, hierna: PAC. Daarnaast dienen de beelden vastgelegd te worden en voor een afgesproken periode bewaard te blijven.

title: Germany – Advertising and marketing services – Fortführung und Weiterentwicklung einer Social-Media- und Web-basierten Informations- und Werbekampagne zur Steigerung der Auslandsmobilität von Studierenden an deutschen Hochschulen
description: Gesucht wird ein Auftragnehmer mit ausgewiesener Expertise im Bereich Social Media und Onlinemarketing für junge Studierende und/oder Schülerinnen und Schüler der gymnasialen Oberstufe. Kern der Kampagne „studieren weltweit – ERLEBE ES!“ ist nutzergenerierter Social-Media-Content von im Ausland studierenden sogenannten „Correspondents“. Der Auftragnehmer verfügt über Erfahrung im Coaching und in der zielgruppengerechten Begleitung solcher Content-Erstellenden. Er übernimmt in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Auftraggeber die strategische und operative Konzeption, Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Social-Media-Kampagne sowie ergänzender Onlinemarketing-Maßnahmen, einschließlich Monitoring und Nutzung der gewonnenen Erkenntnisse für Kampagnenplanung und Betreuung der Correspondents. Die Website www.studieren-weltweit.de wird vor dem Hintergrund einer zunehmenden Nutzung KI-gestützter Informationsangebote weiterentwickelt. Die Kampagne soll eine zeitgemäße, innovative und dynamische Ansprache verfolgen. Der DAAD hat ein bewährtes Kampagnenprofil, ist jedoch offen für strategische Vorschläge zur Anpassung, Weiterentwicklung oder Ergänzung der bestehenden Instrumente im digitalen Raum, um die Zielgruppen hinsichtlich Reichweite und weiterer Erfolgsgrößen optimal zu erreichen. Nähere Einzelheiten sind der Leistungsbeschreibung in Anlage BW2 zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Engineering services – VgV Fachplanung TGA (HLS) - Verbindungsbau Ravensburger Straße 1 und 3 Bad Waldsee
description: Die Große Kreisstadt Bad Waldsee beabsichtigt die Errichtung eines mehrgeschossigen Verbindungsbaus zwischen den Verwaltungsgebäuden Ravensburger Straße 1 und Ravensburger Straße 3 in unmittelbarer Nachbarschaft zum Historischen Rathaus. Ziel der Maßnahme ist die Schaffung eines zentralen und klar erkennbaren Eingangsbereichs, die Verbesserung der Orientierung für Bürgerinnen und Bürger sowie die barrierefreie Erschließung aller Nutzungsebenen der beiden Verwaltungsgebäude. Darüber hinaus ist eine räumliche Optimierung der Bestandsflächen vorgesehen, die durch Umorganisationen sowie geringfügige bauliche Maßnahmen erreicht werden soll. Der Verbindungsbau soll einen Aufzug zur Verbindung der sechs vorhandenen Geschossebenen, ein zusätzliches Treppenhaus als Rettungsweg, öffentliche barrierefreie Sanitäranlagen im Erdgeschoss sowie zusätzliche Büroflächen in den Obergeschossen aufnehmen. Darüber hinaus sind Vorschläge für eine verbesserte Anbindung des Gebäudes Ravensburger Straße 1 an das Historische Rathaus (Hauptstraße 29) zu entwickeln. Dabei soll die Organisation aller Büroeinheiten im Haus überprüft und ggf. angepasst werden. Der Verbindungsbau befindet sich in einer Baulücke und schließt an 3 Seiten an Bestandsgebäude an. Aktuell wird für den Verbindungsbau ein VgV-Verfahren mit Planung durchgeführt. Das Ergebnis dieser Planung wird Mitte Dezember 2026 vorliegen und kann dann zur Verfügung gestellt werden. . Für die Leistungen der Fachplanung TGA gem. §§ 53, 55 HOAI ALG 1-3, optional ALG 8 (HLS), LPH 1-8+9 wird ein geeignetes Ingenieurbüro gesucht. Die Beauftragung soll stufenweise erfolgen. Folgende Anlagengruppen sind vorgesehen: ALG 1 Abwasser-, Wasser-, oder Gasanlagen ALG 2 Wärmeversorgungsanlagen ALG 3 Lufttechnische Anlagen ALG 8 Gebäudeautomation optional. Die geschätzten Gesamtkosten für den Verbindungsbau belaufen sich auf ca. 1,45 Mio. € brutto, der KG 300, 400 und 700. Für die Kostengruppe 300 und 400 wird von ca. 1,2 Mio.€ brutto ausgegangen. Mit der Planung soll unmittelbar nach Beauftragung begonnen werden; die Fertigstellung ist bis Mitte 2028 vorgesehen. Die Fachplanungsleistungen TGA/ELT sind Gegenstand einer separaten Ausschreibung. Die Bestandsunterlagen werden in der 2. Phase zur Verfügung gestellt. . Weitere Informationen entnehmen Sie bitte 5.1. der Bekanntmachung und der angefügten Kurzinformation.

title: RFSA 2026-5203 IT Staff Augmentation Services and Project Delivery Services
description: CDIC is a federal Crown corporation, with headquarters in Ottawa. CDIC is responsible for providing insurance against the loss of part or all of deposits, and for promoting and otherwise contributing to the stability of the financial system in Canada. These objectives are pursued for the benefit of persons having deposits with CDIC member institutions and in such a manner as will minimize the exposure of CDIC to loss. CDIC is also the resolution authority for CDIC member institutions. Further information about CDIC can be obtained at www.cdic.ca. Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation (“CDIC”) is seeking to establish up to twenty (20) Supply Arrangements for Service Stream #1: IT Staff Augmentation Services and an unlimited number of Supply Arrangements for Service Stream #2: Project Delivery Services to provide information technology staff augmentation services and project delivery services as further described in Part 6 (Supply Arrangement and Statement of Work) for any one or both of the following two (2) Service Streams: Service Stream #1: IT Staff Augmentation Services Service Stream #2: Project Delivery Services on an as and when required basis until December 31, 2029. The Services described in the RFSA are meant to provide a high-level framework. The actual scope, deliverables, qualifications and requirements for the Services will be identified at the time of the requirement and further defined in a Service Request. Barring any other conditions or international sanctions, Canadian Suppliers and Suppliers of an Applicable trading partner, as defined in Part 7 (Definitions) are eligible for this procurement. However, qualification under the Supply Arrangement does not guarantee eligibility to compete for all Service Requests. Eligibility for any individual Service Request will be determined by CDIC at the time of issuance of the Service Request based on applicable trade agreements, procurement policies and other legal requirements. Pursuant to the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement, eligibility to individual Service Requests against the Supply Arrangement may be limited to Canadian Suppliers and Suppliers of an Applicable trading partner. Suppliers of an Applicable trading partner will be determined at the individual requirement stage. Individual Service Requests will indicate which suppliers are eligible to compete. The Policy on Prioritizing Canadian Suppliers and Canadian Content in Strategic Federal Procurements may apply to individual Service Requests issued under a supply arrangement resulting from this procurement. Where applicable, those Service Requests will include any required clauses and certifications.

buyer: Newry, Mourne and Down District Council (NMD)
title: CA18515 - RFQ 2026/38 - NMANDD PEACEPLUS "Thriving Together" - Shared History & Culture Program - Hanna's Close
description: Competent consultancy companies are hereby invited to tender to design, develop and deliver a shared history and culture programme that will increase participants' knowledge and understanding of individual, family and collective history through the exploration of Hanna's Close, a preserved Ulster-Scots clachan (settlement) in Aughnahoory, Kilkeel. The programme will place a particular emphasis on genealogy; tracing family connections linked to Hanna's Close and examining patterns of emigration from the settlement. Participants will explore how generations of local families established new lives across the world and consider the social, economic and cultural impact these individuals and their descendants have had on communities both locally and internationally. To access this competition: Registered: Login to https://suppliers.multiquote.com and view the opportunity CA18515. Not registered: Visit https://suppliers.multiquote.com then register and quote CA18515 as the reason for registration. Any queries please contact MultiQuote on 020 3920 8054.

title: Linstone Housing Landscape Maintenance Contract 2026-2029
description: The Contract will principally comprise litter picking, grass cutting, shrub bed & hedging, ad-hoc moss clearance of hard standing areas maintenance and leaf collection landscape maintenance services to existing properties and common landscaped areas throughout Renfrewshire to the areas detailed within the Landscape Architects MAP’s. The Contract may also include tree maintenance services, tree and stump removal works, and repairs to existing damaged grass areas. The Contract, as tendered, only includes properties and landscaped areas throughout Linwood, Johnstone and Paisley. However, Linstone Housing also provide services to their customers in Bridge of Weir, Renfrew, Elderslie and Kilbarchan, and additional properties or landscaped areas throughout Renfrewshire may be introduced by Linstone Housing during the Contract. Shrubs bed maintenance will mainly be undertaken by the Estates Management Team of Linstone Housing rather than the Contractor. However, the Contractor will be required to undertake shrub bed maintenance to the following estates/MAP’s, the areas of which have been incorporated within the tender pricing document; 1. M02 Rev B Dykebar – areas S11 and S12 to be maintained by the Contractor. Bidders are advised that areas S11 and S12 are actually hedging and have been incorrectly recorded as shrub bed areas on MAP M02 2. M10 Rev B Sandyflats – areas S1 and S2 to be maintained by the Contractor; 3. M19 Rev B Town Centre – all shrub beds to be maintained by the Contractor; and 4. M20 Rev B Abernethy Drive – all shrub beds to be maintained by the Contractor. Bidders are also advised that Linstone Housing do not anticipate the Contractor having to undertake any works during the contract at the following estates/MAPS’s; a. M01 Bridge of Weir; b. M04 Glen Street Paisley; c. M06 Johnstone Castle; d. M07 Rev A Kilbarchan; e. M08 Renfrew Rd or Kirklandneuk; f. M09 Corseford; g. M21 Brown Street; and h. M22 Ellerslie Street. Bidders are further advised that the grass area G1 detailed on MAP M10 Rev B Sandyflats is rough grass and will receive only one rough grass cut per annum. The Estates Management Team of Linstone Housing will also generally undertake moss clearance of hard standing areas with the exception of the hard standing areas detailed on M02 Rev B Dykebar. The Contractor will be required to undertake moss clearance three times annually (April, June and October) to the hard standing areas detailed on M02 Rev B Dykebar.

title: Anskaffelse av løsning for backup og reservedrift
description: Plan- og bygningsetaten forvalter store mengder data knyttet til byggesaker, eiendom, geodata og mer. Stabil tilgang til disse dataene er avgjørende for å sikre effektiv saksbehandling og leveranse av tjenester til innbyggere og næringsliv. Anskaffelsens formål er å etablere en sikker og robust løsning for sikkerhetskopiering og gjenoppretting av data. Løsningen som anskaffes skal bidra til å sikre høy tilgjengelighet til etatens data og systemer og redusere risiko knyttet til tap av data, sikkerhetshendelser og driftsavbrudd. Løsningen skal understøtte etatens behov for: - beskyttelse av virksomhetskritiske data - rask gjenoppretting ved hendelser - robusthet mot cybertrusler (herunder ransomware) - fleksibilitet i forbindelse med overgang til Oslo kommunes felles IKT-plattform Anskaffelsen omfatter en samlet løsning for backup og gjenoppretting som kan bestå av: - tjenesteleveranse fra leverandørens plattform - drift av løsninger i kundens eller tredjeparts miljø - nødvendige komponenter for lagring og gjenoppretting Løsningen skal sikre at sikkerhetskopier lagres på minst to uavhengige lokasjoner, som er fysisk og logisk adskilt.

title: Finland – Wide area network services – Tietoliikennepalvelut ja valokuituverkon myynti
description: Hankintayksikkö pyytää tarjousta seuraavasta palvelukokonaisuudesta: • Tietoliikenneverkko sekä tähän liittyviä optioita. Toimittajan tulee tarjota kokonaisuutta. Osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Kyseisen kokonaisuuden tarkemmat tiedot ja tarjousvaatimukset löytyvät tarjouspyynnön liitteestä 1, jossa on ilmoitettu tarjottavien palveluiden vähimmäis- ja laatuvaatimukset. Osana hankintaa myydään Tilaajan omistaman kuituverkon yhteyksiä Toimittajalle. Toimittaja ilmoittaa hintaliitteellä hinnan, jonka se kuituverkosta maksaa Tilaajalle. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska kyseessä on tekninen ja toiminnallinen kokonaisuus, jonka jakaminen osiin muodostaisi Tilaajalle merkittävän teknisen ja toiminnallisen riskin sekä saattaisi merkittävästi haitata kriittisten tietoliikenneyhteyksien saatavuutta tulevaisuudessa. Hankinnassa noudatetaan hankintalakia (1397/2016). Menettelytapana on EU kynnysarvon ylittävä avoin menettely. Tarjouspyyntöasiakirjat ovat suomen kielellä ja tarjous tulee antaa suomen kielellä. Tarjoajan tulee huomioida, että hankinta-asiakirjojen saantia on rajoitettu hankintalain 69.3 §:n perusteella: Kaikkia hankinta-asiakirjoja ei voida asettaa rajoituksetta, suoraan ja kokonaan sähköisessä muodossa saataville tietojen luottamuksellisuuden suojaamiseksi. Tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoihin liittyy salassa pidettävää aineistoa (Tarjouspyynnön liite 4 - Kohdeluettelo). Menettelyohjeet salassapidettävän materiaalin saamiseksi on ilmoitettu hankintailmoituksen kohdassa: "Hankintaa tai osaa koskevat lisätiedot". Learnpoint ICT Oy toimii hankinnassa konsulttina.

title: HEPIA - Rue de la Prairie 4 - Assainissement et rénovation des sous-stations de distribution de chauffage B-C-D-I
description:
DESCRIPTIF DES TRAVAUX


Le projet concerne la rénovation complète des trois sous-stations de distribution de chauffage et de production dʼeau chaude sanitaire des bâtiments B, C et D de lʼHépia, sis au 4, rue de la Prairie à Genève.

Cette rénovation a pour objectif dʼadapter les installations aux exigences actuelles en matière dʼefficacité et dʼoptimisation énergétique, ainsi que dʼassurer leur compatibilité et leur fonctionnement optimal avec la nouvelle production de chaleur des Services industriels de Genève (SIG).

Le présent appel dʼoffres concerne exclusivement les installations de chauffage des trois sous-stations, lesquelles feront lʼobjet dʼune rénovation complète.

Les travaux sont prévus durant la période comprise entre mai et octobre 2027.

Les soumissionnaires devront intégrer dans lʼétablissement de leurs offres lʼensemble des contraintes liées à lʼexécution des travaux, notamment les conditions particulières dʼaccès, de phasage et dʼexploitation des bâtiments et installations existantes.


Les principales contraintes à prendre en considération sont les suivantes :


• Les travaux seront réalisés simultanément dans les trois sous-stations.

• Les travaux seront exécutés en site occupé. Le soumissionnaire devra ainsi prendre toutes les dispositions nécessaires afin de limiter les nuisances et les perturbations liées à lʼexécution des travaux.

• Des aménagements d'horaires pourront être imposés ou convenus en fonction de la nature des interventions, notamment lorsque celles-ci sont susceptibles de générer des nuisances pour les occupants ou dʼentraîner une interruption temporaire des installations.

• La sous-station B est située au premier niveau du parking public, géré par la Fondation des Parkings. Le parking restera en exploitation pendant toute la durée des travaux.

• Le soumissionnaire devra tenir compte des contraintes liées au maintien en exploitation du parking, notamment en ce qui concerne l'accès au chantier, l'acheminement et l’évacuation du matériel, le stockage temporaire des fournitures ainsi que la sécurité des usagers.

• Lʼentreprise devra assurer en permanence la sécurité des occupants, des usagers du parking et du personnel intervenant sur le chantier, conformément aux prescriptions en vigueur.


Le soumissionnaire est réputé avoir pris connaissance des contraintes liées au site et devra les intégrer dans son offre ainsi que dans son organisation et son planning d'exécution.

description: SOLICITATION NOTICE / REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS (RFQ): N0017826R2500 PROJECT TITLE: Commercial Warehousing, Storage, and Logistics Support Services CONTRACTING ACTIVITY: Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division (NSWCDD) / Combat Direction Systems Activity (CDSA) Dam Neck 1. GENERAL INFORMATION & SPECIAL NOTICE REGARDING SOLICITATION IDENTIFIER This notice constitutes the official solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with FAR Part 12 (Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services) and FAR Subpart 13.5 (Simplified Procedures for Certain Commercial Items), using the publicizing procedures of FAR Part 5 and FAR 12.603. *** SPECIAL NOTICE REGARDING SOLICITATION IDENTIFIER & NOTICE FORMAT *** Offerors are advised that while this opportunity is formally posted under SAM.gov�s "Solicitation" notice type and bears an "R" in the Procurement Instrument Identifier (PIID: N0017826R2500) due to agency electronic procurement system conventions, THIS ACTION IS LEGALLY AND PROCEDURALLY CONDUCTED AS A REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS (RFQ) UNDER SIMPLIFIED ACQUISITION PROCEDURES (FAR SUBPART 13.5). - This procurement does NOT utilize formal negotiated contracting procedures under FAR Part 15. - There is no formal Source Selection Evaluation Board (SSEB), Source Selection Plan (SSP), or competitive range determination. - Written quotations are being requested under simplified commercial procedures, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued beyond this announcement and the attached SF 1449 package. - The resulting award will be a standalone, commercial Firm-Fixed-Price "C-Type" contract. PROCUREMENT METADATA: - NAICS Code: 493110 � General Warehousing and Storage - Small Business Size Standard: $34.0 Million - Product Service Code (PSC): R706 � Support- Management: Logistics Support - DPAS Rating Assigned: DO-C9 - Set-Aside: 100% Set-Aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) pursuant to FAR 19.14 and FAR Subpart 13.5. 2. SUMMARY OF REQUIREMENT NSWCDD requires contractor-provided commercial warehousing, physical storage, inventory management, material handling, and freight transportation support services to support Operating Materials & Supplies (OM&S) and Plant Property & Equipment (PP&E) / General Equipment for CDSA Dam Neck in the Hampton Roads, VA area. *** NOTE: Full facility specifications, dimensional requirements, environmental controls, and performance standards are detailed in the attached Statement of Work (SOW). *** 3. NOTICE OF VEHICLE ALIGNMENT & PRIOR NOTICE SUPERSESSION This notice serves as the official open-market solicitation published directly to SAM.gov (Contract Opportunities). Any prior notices, sources sought, or pre-solicitation announcements referencing the intent to utilize the General Services Administration (GSA) Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) or GSA eBuy are hereby superseded. This procurement is conducted on an open-market basis under FAR Part 12 and FAR Subpart 13.5. 4. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS & BASIS FOR AWARD - Eligibility: Quotes will only be accepted from SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) registered under NAICS 493110 in SAM.gov and certified in the SBA VetCert portal. Offers submitted by non-certified entities or firms exceeding the $34.0M size standard will not be considered. - Basis for Award: Award will be made to the responsible offeror whose quote represents the Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) to the Government pursuant to FAR 13.106-2. Technical acceptability will be evaluated on a Pass/Fail basis against the mandatory minimum requirements set forth in the SOW. - Pricing: Offerors are encouraged to submit published pricing, standard commercial pricelists, historical contract pricing data, or other information to support the Government�s price analysis and determination of fair and reasonable pricing in accordance with FAR 13.106-3. - Questions Deadline: Questions regarding this solicitation must be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist no later than October 13, 2026 at 12:00 PM Eastern Time. - Quotation Due Date: Complete quotations must be received electronically via email no later than October 29, 2026 at 12:00 PM Eastern Time. Submissions must reference Solicitation Number N0017826R2500 in the subject line. description: The award resulting from this RFP will be an Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) supply contract with prepriced ELINS for the Overhaul of MK 41 Vertical Launch System (VLS) Cell Catches and Uptake Hatches. Ordering periods will span five (5) years. Hatches will be picked up and returned to SERMC at Naval Station Mayport in Jacksonville, Florida. Overhauls will be conducted at the contractor's facility. description: Le présent accord-cadre a pour objet la maintenance préventive et corrective des installations de détection et de protection incendie de l’Imprimerie de la Banque de France à Vic-le-Comte (DGMP). Il s’agit d’un accord-cadre composite (partie forfaitaire + BPU) mono-attributaire pour une durée ferme de deux ans, renouvelable deux fois un an, soit quatre ans maximum. title: Kingdom of Bahrain S&RTS
description: The purpose of this requirement is to provide S&RTS in connection with the import and export of designated U.S. Government (USG) cargo throughout the Kingdom of Bahrain. Primary performance locations include Mina Salman Port, Khalifa Bin Salman Port, ASRY Dry Dock, Naval Support Activity (NSA1), Mina Salman Naval Base (NSA2), Shaikh Isa Air Base, Aviation Unit (NSA3), Riffa Air Base and any other designated locations within Kingdom of Bahrain. S&RTS services will cover the full spectrum of managing USG cargo (e.g. containers, vehicles, breakbulk, and rotary or fixed wing aircraft) transiting through the specified port(s) in this contract. Operational tasks shall include but are not limited to stevedoring and long-shoring services required to conduct and facilitate load and discharge of vessel, truck, port reception and disposition, cargo management and preparation, staging, storage, onward movement, intra-port transfers, vessel preparation, documentation, tallying and checking, and storage of dunnage and tiedown materials. Military cargo may consist of vehicles, Ammunition and Explosives (A&E) in all sizes and configurations (containerized or breakbulk), non-explosive containers of all sizes, all classes of Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) (IAW applicable regulations), and other general DoW cargo. Transportation will be facilitated via vessel, Common-User Land Transportation (CULT), and/or military convoy.

description: Combined Synopsis/Solicitation FA8224-27-Q-0001 Portable Fire Extinguisher & Fire Suppression System Services For the benefit of AMXG, Hill AFB, UT This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with RFO Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number FA8224-27-Q-0001 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for monthly and annual inspection, maintenance, and monitoring of portable fire extinguishers, and annual fire suppression system inspection located within AMXG facilities at Hill AFB, Utah. As provided in the attached statement of work, all work on this contract shall comply with applicable federal, state, local, and Hill AFB fire prevention regulations It is the Government�s intention to establish a Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) with a single entity for a one-year period with four additional option years. The Government is obligated only to the extent of authorized purchases actually made under the BPA by an authorized individual, and then only when performance of services has been made and accepted by the Government. All qualified sources are encouraged to submit a quote which will be considered by the agency. Contractors must provide proof of valid and active licensing issued by the Utah State Fire Marshal for servicing portable fire extinguishers as well as fire suppression systems. Contractor personnel must possess an active certification of registration by the Utah State Fire Marshal at time of service. Contractors must be registered at SAM.gov and have an active CAGE code at the time of response. A company that is not registered in SAM.gov or which does not possess an active CAGE code may contact APEX Accelerators for assistance in completing the registration process. A document with the APEX Accelerators contact information is included in this solicitation. Respondents to this solicitation shall specify whether the entity is a large business, 8(a) concern, women-owned small business, HUBZone small business, veteran-owned small business, service-disabled veteran-owned small business. Respondents must also specify whether they are a U.S.-owned or foreign-owned firm. This acquisition is 100% set-aside for small business concerns. To be considered a small business for this solicitation a company�s annual revenue may not exceed $25M. The NAICS Code for this solicitation is 561621. The provision at RFO 52.212-1, Instructions to Offerors � Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition. Quotations are due by Noon Mountain Daylight Saving Time on Friday, 30 October 2026 via electronic mail to ammon.helms@us.af.mil. Quoters are responsible for verifying receipt of Quote. Oral quotes will not be accepted. To be considered for award. Quoters are responsible for including the following eight items in their response: The solicitation number The name, address, telephone number of the Quoter A CAGE code and active SAM.gov Unique Entity ID. An active Portable Fire Extinguisher Company Privilege License Number issued by the Utah State Fire Marshal. An active Fire Suppression Systems Company Privilege License Number issued by the Utah State Fire Marshal. A company profile and capabilities statement that may not exceed one single-sided, letter-sized page. Completed FA8224-27-Q-0001 Pricing Response Form An affirmative statement specifying the extent of agreement with all terms, conditions, and provisions included in the solicitation and any solicitation amendments. description: This is a sources sought notice. All products must be Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved. The products must be delivered Just-In-Time (JIT), Direct Vendor Delivery (DVD) and Consignment. Under the JIT delivery method, the Medical Treatment Facility (MTF) calls the manufacturer�s field representative who carriers the products into the MTF just-in-time for the surgery. Under the DVD method an order for products is placed through ECAT and the products are delivered direct to the customer via any transportation carrier. Under the consignment method MTFs will have the products that make up the procedural package consigned to their facility. At the request of the MTFs, the manufacturer is required to have a qualified representative on site at the MTFs within the timeframe specified by the facility necessary to meet their requirements. Furthermore, technical support is available twenty-four (24) hours a day, seven (7) days a week. description: SOURCES SOUGHT For $499M AE General Services MATOC U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Southwestern Division (SWD) ARCHITECT-ENGINEER INDEFINITE DELIVERY CONTRACT FOR GENERAL DESIGN AND OTHER RELATED SERVICES WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES OF OR ASSIGNED TO SOUTHWESTERN DIVISION, UNITED STATES ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS This is a SOURCES SOUGHT announcement; a market survey for information only, to be used for preliminary planning purposes. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SOURCE SOUGHT. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this sources sought notice or any follow up information requests. Respondents will be notified of the results of the evaluation upon request. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) � Southwestern Division(SWD) is conducting market research to determine the interest and capability of firms to submit Standard Form 330 (SF-330) Architect-Engineer Qualifications statements for an eight-year $499M indefinite delivery contract(s) (IDC). The decision of whether or not to include any type of set-aside or reserve within the IDC pool will depend upon the responses to this sources sought announcement and associated market research. The purpose of this sources sought notice is to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of various members of industry, to include the Small Business Community: Small Business, Section 8(a), Historically Underutilized Business Zones (HUB-Zone), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), and Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB), as well as Unrestricted Businesses. The Government must ensure there is adequate competition among the potential pool of responsible contractors. Small businesses, Section 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, and WOSB businesses are highly encouraged to participate. Project Scope: A full range of A-E services for engineering and design are anticipated, which may include, but are not limited to any or all of the following: program management, data management, project programming and planning, feasibility and concept studies, space utilization, design concepts/standards, research, analysis, engineering, design, design/build request for proposal preparation, and engineering during construction for military, civil works and interagency services. Engineering and design within these services also include, but are not limited to, design of new construction, vertical and horizontal, alteration of facilities, maintenance and repair of real property, pre-design site assessment, topographic and boundary surveys to include mapping, geotechnical investigation and reports, environmental investigations, studies and reports, hazardous materials testing, abatement and monitoring, historical and cultural resource investigations, seismic studies, cost estimates, value engineering, design reviews, life cycle costing, computer aided drafting, geospatial information systems (GIS), and building information modeling (BIM). buyer: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF
title: Head Start in State Systems Sole Source Award
description: This requirement was awarded through task order 47QRAA-20D-001M/7571MN26F80105 This requirement will support the generation and dissemination of research and/or evaluation that builds on the Financing Early Care and Education (ECE) Study task order (47QRAA-20D-001M/ 140D0422F0154). The primary objective is to generate and disseminate evidence pertaining to the financing of early care and education programs that meet child, family, and community needs. Building on data collected under the prior contract, this project will identify and elevate strategies used to align Head Start programs within state funding contexts to reduce administrative burden and expand the reach of ECE and Head Start funding. The research will focus on how Head Start programs operate within state systems and highlight effective strategies states have used to integrate or build upon Head Start funding within their broader early childhood systems. The project will also examine how efforts to streamline licensing and regulatory requirements, workforce standards, and supports for quality and technical assistance across funding streams can reduce burden, improve program efficiency, increase parental access to ECE, and support child and family outcomes. This requirement will build on prior efforts to identify and elevate financing approaches for states that most effectively align funding streams to both reduce burden and increase the reach of ECE funding. This project will provide ACF with critical evidence to understand how federal early care and education programs can achieve the Agency�s mission and vision of (1) supporting federalism & local leadership by providing actionable insights into how states and localities can leverage Head Start and other federal funding streams for early care and education (ECE) to best meet local needs, (2) promoting quality early learning environments and improved child outcomes by understanding how to leverage existing funding sources to best meet the preferences of families with young children consistent with their unique needs, and (3) promoting work and self-sufficiency by exploring how leveraging funds can expand the availability of ECE services that allow parents to work.

title: D.C. Metro Area Multiple Award Indefinite Quantity Indefinite Delivery (IDIQ) Contract for Construction Services
description: AMENDMENT 001, Issued 9/30/26. The due date for proposals is Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 4:00PM Eastern Time.(Page 6 of the Solicitation indicates 4:00PM EST. It should have stated 4:00PM EDT or 4:00PM Eastern Time. This amendment is being issued for clarity.) ALL OTHER TERMS REMAIN UNCHANGED. OFFERORS MUST ACKNOWLEDGE ALL AMENDMENTS WITH THEIR PROPOSAL. Point of contact: Jay Oxenberg; jay.oxenberg@gsa.gov Set-Aside: The Procurement will be a Total Small Business Set-Aside with Reserves. Reserves will be allocated for 8(a), HUBZone, Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB), and Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). More detailed information regarding the Reserves is included in the solicitation document. PSC Code: Z2AA NAICS Code: 236220 Small Business Size Standard: $45M Description: This is a Multiple Award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract that provides for an indefinite quantity of supplies or services during a fixed period. The GSA intends to award multiple contracts for General Construction Services. After award of the IDIQ all awardees will be provided fair opportunity in accordance with FAR 16.507-2 for discrete construction projects where a single task order will be issued based on selection criteria established at the ordering level, unless an exemption exists in accordance with FAR 16.507-6. The General Contractor (GC) shall serve as the single point of responsibility and must supervise, administer, coordinate, perform, and contract all management, labor, materials, equipment, and construction activities required to successfully execute each assigned project. Construction services will be required to be performed at federally owned and leased locations. The operational scope encompasses comprehensive general construction, repair, alteration, and modernization services for existing real property facilities. The General Contractor (GC) shall supervise, administer, perform, and contract all construction activities required to complete a project. Construction services include, but are not limited to office construction and/or renovations/repairs, office space renovations, MEP (Mechanical/Electrical/Plumbing) repairs/modifications/replacement, fire sprinkler systems repairs/modification/replacement, sitework, exterior construction repair and alterations (including facades and roofs), demolition (including abatement of hazardous materials), elevator modernizations, work in technically sensitive environments like laboratories, SCIF�s etc., work in high-security data centers and critical infrastructure control systems, construction work in high security buildings, as well as any other general construction activities. The scope will include design-build services. The GC may be required to utilize the following delivery methods to deliver projects for the GSA: 1. Design/Bid/Build (DBB) Traditional 2. Design/Build (D/B) The primary geography will cover: -All of Washington, D.C. -Virginia: Arlington County, Fairfax County, Loudon County, Independent Cities of Alexandria, Fairfax, and Falls Church -Maryland: Montgomery County, Prince George's County The Government may unilaterally expand the geography to cover any additional counties in the states of Maryland and Virginia. GSA reserves the right to expand, within scope, the geographic areas covered by the awarded contracts by bilateral agreement with any or all contract holders based on agency needs and requirements. The Maximum Ordering Limit (MOL) for this contract vehicle is $500,000,000.00. Meaning the cumulative total for all task orders awarded to all contractors over the life of the contract (5 Years) is not anticipated to exceed $500,000,000.00. There is no MOL per contractor or per performance period. The general task order range will be between $350,000.00 and $10,000,000.00. There will be a base period of one (1) year, and there will be four (4) option periods of one-year each, for a total possible performance period of five (5) years. The government intends to award approximately eighteen (18) contracts, inclusive of a target of twelve (12) contract reserves. However, the Government reserves the right to make more, fewer, or no awards, depending on the results of the evaluation, availability of funding, and the Government�s needs. The government is reserving three (3) contracts each for the following socioeconomic designations: 8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, SDVOSB, for a target of twelve (12) contract reserves. However, the Government reserves the right to make more, fewer, or no reserve awards, depending on the results of the evaluation, availability of funding, and the Government�s needs. Award Methodology This solicitation will be executed pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 15.103-3 (RFO-2025-15), Highest technically rated with a fair and reasonable price approach. Pursuant to FAR Clause 52.215-1 Instructions to Offerors-Competitive Acquisition, and FAR 15.203 (RFO-2025-15), the Government intends to evaluate proposals and make competitive awards without negotiations with offerors although it reserves the right to negotiate should it be determined to be necessary. Competitive proposals shall be evaluated and assessed based on the factors specified in this solicitation. For this solicitation, all evaluation factors other than cost or price, when combined, are significantly more important than price. The Technical Evaluation Factors will be: Prior Experience Past Performance Evidence of Bonding Capacity: Go/No Go. (Minimum- $10M per project) Prior Experience is relatively more important than Past Performance. More detailed information regarding the technical factors and award methodology is included in the solicitation. Awards are anticipated to be made in February of 2027. Pre-Proposal Conference: A virtual pre-proposal conference will be held on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 @ 10:00AM EST and will be held via Google Meet. Registration is required by Monday, October 5, 2026 at 3:00PM EST. A link to the meeting will be provided upon registration. The Contracting Officer will also email the link to the email address provided by registrants. Do not share this link with others. A shared link may not allow entry to the virtual meeting. There is a registration link attached in this SAM notice, as well as on page five (5) of the solicitation document. More information about the format and content of the pre-proposal conference is listed on page five (5) of the solicitation document. Interested Parties/How to Offer: The Solicitation will only be available electronically. The solicitation can only be obtained by accessing SAM.gov. Potential offerors will be responsible for downloading the solicitation and for monitoring the website for possible amendments and/or additional information. Potential offerors must be registered in SAM.gov. All responsible and qualified small businesses may submit a proposal in response to the solicitation, and the proposal will be considered by the agency. Inquiries concerning the requirement should be directed to the following email address: jay.oxenberg@gsa.gov. DISCLAIMER: The official solicitation package is located on the official Government web page and the Government is not liable for information furnished by any other source. Amendments, if/when issued will be posted to the SAM.gov site for electronic downloading. This will normally be the only method of distributing amendments prior to closing; therefore, it is the offeror's responsibility to check the website periodically for any amendments to the solicitation. Websites are occasionally inaccessible due to various reasons. The Government is not responsible for any loss of Internet connectivity or for an offeror's inability to access the documents posted on the referenced web pages. The Government will not issue paper copies of this solicitation.

description: The requirement is for providing Gardening Services for properties owned or managed by the United States Government as official office and operational space for the Mission in Bogot�, Colombia. The Contractor shall provide comprehensive gardening and landscape maintenance services for the U.S. Embassy Bogota compound. These services shall include all planning, administration, and management necessary to ensure compliance with the contract, the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) schedules and instructions, and all applicable best practices, laws, and regulations. The Contractor must meet all performance standards specified in the contract. The Contractor shall also perform all related support functions, including but not limited to human resources management, quality control, technical oversight, and phytosanitary supervision. The green areas of the U.S. Embassy Bogota compound cover approximately 28,000 square meters, as highlighted in the reference image below. Areas requiring gardening services include lawns, trees, palms, shrubs, hedges, bushes, vines, ground cover, flower beds, and selected indoor plants. In addition, the scope of services includes all roofs and hard surfaces where activities must be performed, as described in this Statement of Work (SOW). The scope also includes the immediate exterior perimeter, primarily planters and exterior gardens at the entrances to the Embassy compound. The anticipated performance period is for a base year, with four one-year option periods, and a possibility of 6 months extension if exercised by the Government. title: Encroachment Management Implementation and Mission Readiness, Sustainment, and Compatibility Services AE IDIQ, Unrestricted
description: THIS IS AN UNRESTRICTED PROCUREMENT. This procurement will result in one Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract for multi-discipline Architect-Engineer (A-E) services for Encroachment Management Implementation and Mission Readiness, Sustainment, and Compatibility services at various Navy and Marine Corps installations primarily in the Navy Region Southwest but may also include work worldwide. These services will be procured in accordance with 40 USC Chapter 11, Selection of Architects and Engineers, as implemented by FAR 36. The IDIQ contract will be for a base period of two (2) years and three (3) one-year option periods (if exercised). The total fee for the contract term shall not exceed $30,000,000. The guaranteed minimum for the contract term (including option years) is $1,000. Firm-fixed price task orders will be negotiated for this contract. The minimum value of individual task orders executed under this contract is $25,000. The maximum value of individual task orders executed under this contract is $2,500,000. There will be no dollar limit per year. Estimated start date is March 2027. The Small Business size standard classification is North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) Code 541330 (Engineering Services). The Government seeks the most highly qualified firm to perform the required services, based on the demonstrated competence and qualifications, in accordance with the selection criteria. Primary A-E Services: 1. Land Use Planning. 2. Air Installations Compatible Use Zones (AICUZ) and Range Air Installations Compatible Use Zones (RAICUZ) Studies. 3. Encroachment Action Plans (EAP) or Encroachment Control Plans (ECP). 4. Strategic Engagement and Communication Plans (SECP). 5. Outreach Planning Materials. 6. Electronic Database. Secondary Services: 1. Other related studies/analysis: Provide additional services to assist in implementation of encroachment management studies, Range Complex Management Plans (RCMP), Integrated Natural Resource Management Plans (INRMP), Readiness and Environmental Protection Integration (REPI) Program plans, and other special planning, engineering, and encroachment support deliverables, such as analytical assessments, geospatial analysis and simulations, traffic studies, glint/glare analysis, radar assessments, plume analysis and modeling, lighting studies, and socio-economic studies. 2. Other Related Reports or Documentation: Deliverables also include assistance with incidental services related to providing public notice for studies and publicizing and providing training on encroachment-related studies. Please see attached synopsis for full synopsis description/instructions.

title: Sea Range Safety Surveillance Services
description: 1) INTRODUCTION AND PURPOSE: NAWCWD is seeking technically competent sources for engineering services in support of Test and Evaluation (T&E) and systems engineering activities related to Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) and Theater High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) programs at Pacific Missile Range Facility (PMRF). The purpose of this sources sought is to determine what companies are capable of providing the required services in a competitive procurement and to gain market knowledge of potential qualified sources and their size classifications relative to the North American Industry Classification Systems (NAICS) code 541330 for Engineering Services which has a corresponding size standard of $47 million. Responses to this sources sought synopsis will be utilized by the Government to determine the best acquisition strategy for this procurement and make appropriate determinations about potential sources. No solicitation is currently available and as such this is not a request for proposal and in no way obligates the Government to award any contract. A decision to set aside all or part of this requirement is dependent upon a review of the information submitted in response to this sources sought. After review of responses to this sources sought, a synopsis and/or solicitation announcement may be published. (2) PROGRAM DESCRIPTION: This requirement is for engineering services to be provided in support of Test and Evaluation (T&E) and systems engineering activities primarily related to Aegis-Based Defense, formerly Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) and Sea-Based Weapon Systems. Engineering service are provided to other entities, including (but not limited to) Program Executive Office Integrated Warfare Systems (PEO IWS), various Hypersonic programs, and Allied Foreign Military Sales (FMS) partners. Aegis-Based Defense is one weapon system in the layered defense provided for the United States and its deployed forces, friends and allies against ballistic missiles of all ranges in all phases of flight. This defense is provided through an integrated Ballistic Missile Defense System (BMDS), developed by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA). MDA is responsible for fulfilling the goals set out in the National Missile Defense Act of 1999 in deploying �as soon as is technologically possible an effective National Missile Defense system capable of defending the territory of the United States against limited ballistic missile attack�. In support of this goal, the Aegis-Based Defense program needs to collect high fidelity system under test and auxiliary sensor data in order to evaluate the results of the flight test and to determine if the system(s) met the mission objectives. Additionally, auxiliary sensor data is highly valuable in providing forensics for any anomalies that may have occurred during these events. Pre-/post-mission data analyses of this auxiliary sensor data is critical these flight test scenarios. This is a follow-on contract to N6893622D0024. The existing contract is Cost-Plus Fixed-Fee (CPFF), Level of Effort (LOE), and was awarded to Raytheon (RTX) on a sole source basis. The new contract will be a Firm Fixed Price (FFP). (3) REQUIRED CAPABILITIES: The MDA / Aegis-Based Defense program requires high fidelity pre-mission planning, real-time mission conduct and execution support, post-mission data analysis, and reporting of test results of high profile flight test events. Support shall be provided to various flight test events and systems engineering activities. This includes mission planning, test planning, generating test procedures, real-time mission conduct, data collection, real-time range safety mission support, mission data analyses and reporting, operations research support, and technical management support. Aegis-Based Defense requires support for test planning, test conduct, data reduction/analysis, and reporting of auxiliary sensor data during flight test events. This includes in-depth pre-mission analysis, which provides inputs to instrumentation, sensor data collection CONOPS, and sensor configurations to maximize valuable data collection. Recommendations for test support positions (TSPs) to auxiliary sensors will aid in maximizing valuable data collected. Inputs to test plans as well as mission requirements are needed to ensure mission test objectives are met. This includes auxiliary tracking and data collection objectives based on mission priorities and overall test objectives. Understanding test objectives will translate directly into what instrumentation should be used and how they should be configured. This includes inputs to all test participants (sea-based, ground-based, airborne, and space-based). Real-time mission conduct support assists auxiliary sensor participants to make adjustments to configurations, tracking objectives, and/or tracking CONOPS based on changes to mission scenarios. This support can ensure successful data collection during live missile and test vehicle launches. Mission conduct and execution support includes providing sensor and analysis support to assist range safety. Complex analyses and reporting of test results is needed to evaluate weapons and weapon systems to ensure mission test objectives have been met. This includes ingesting, reducing, processing, and analyzing all auxiliary data (optical, radar, telemetry) and data formats. Analyses and test results should be shared with the government and test community to ensure proper communication and collaboration. (4) PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: This effort will primarily be performed at PMRF at Barking Sands, Kauai, HI. Support will also be conducted at the following national test ranges and locations: Joint Base Pearl Harbor Hickam (JBPHH) on Oahu, HI; Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division (NAWCWD) Point Mugu Sear Range (PMSR) at Point Mugu, CA; Vandenberg Space Force Base (SFB) in CA; Reagan Test Site (RTS) on Kwajalein Atoll; Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson (JBER) in AK; Cape Canaveral Space Force Station (CCSFS) at Cape Canaveral, FL; Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division (NAWCAD) at Patuxent River, MD; and the Missile Defense Integration and Operations Center (MDIOC) at Colorado Springs, CO. (5) CONTRACT TYPE: The Government is considering a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Idefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with a five-year Ordering Period. (6) SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS: The Government requests that responses to this sources sought include the following: demonstrated capability to ingest, reduce, process, and analyze auxiliary sensor data and applicable data formats for the MDA /Aegis-Based Defense program. Auxiliary sensor data includes optics, radar, and telemetry, and applicable formats include binary, ASCII, and movie formats (h264, mp4, mkv, avi, mpg, etc.). Data analyses includes data reduction, data tracking algorithms, signature generation, data display/visualization, brightness/contrast and image enhancement, data registration, image sequence output, and background subtraction. Demonstrated capability to generate an early track of a launch vehicle to provide a state vector solution to range safety entities for immediate awareness and assessment of the vehicle trajectory status to the range safety officer. This will allow range safety to take corrective action (if needed) and prevent the vehicle from violating range safety boundaries (i.e. � IIP destruct limits, safe firing bearings, etc.). This system must be capable of meeting all range safety assessment criteria, including latency times, data rate, and first state vector solution time. Demonstrate ability to support Navy optical data collection aircraft with optical Subject Matter Expert (SME) for mission planning, sensor calibrations, real-time inputs to tracking operators, mission conduct, and post-mission data analysis. Demonstrate familiarity with test ranges, range instrumentation, range safety criteria, and range data collection capabilities. Assessment of test range

title: Mandat: Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Einführung der Versorgungsregion Brugg (Alters- und Langzeitversorgung) – Pilotprojekt
description:
Der Regionalplanungsverband Brugg Regio lanciert zusammen mit dem Kanton Aargau ein Pilotprojekt zur Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Einführung einer Versorgungsregion Brugg im Bereich der Alters- und Langzeitversorgung. Ziel ist der Aufbau einer koordinierten, regional abgestimmten Versorgungsstruktur in Zusammenarbeit mit der bestehenden Koordinationsstelle Alter, den Gemeinden sowie weiteren lokalen Akteuren, gestützt auf das Konzept für die Pilotphase und die Gesundheitspolitische Gesamtplanung des Kantons Aargau.

Die Leistungserbringung wird als Mandat ausgeschrieben.

Das Pilotprojekt dauert 3 1/2 Jahre.


Zentrale Punkte in der Ausschreibung

A. Leistungsbeschreibung

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines Versorgungskonzepts für eine künftige Versorgungsregion Brugg
  • Aufbau der Zusammenarbeit mit der bestehenden Koordinationsstelle Alter und den weiteren lokalen Akteuren
  • Erstellen einer Meilensteinplanung
  • Erarbeitung eines Wegweisers für die Bevölkerung zur Versorgungsregion
  • Entwickeln eines Monitorings zur Versorgungsregion
  • Entwicklung und Führung von statistischen Grundlagen und weiteren strategischen Aufgaben
  • Beratung der Gemeinden und Akteure der Versorgungsregion
  • Stakeholder-Management (Gemeinden, Leistungserbringer, Kanton)
  • Verfassen von Stellungnahmen zu politischen Vorstössen und Gesetzesvorlagen
  • Berichterstattung gegenüber der Arbeitsgruppe Gesundheit und dem Vorstand von Regio Brugg
  • Planung einer Verankerung der Versorgungsregion und deren Organisation nach der Pilotphase oder Abschluss des Projekts



B. Projektziele & Meilensteine

  • Jährliche Evaluation des Projektverlaufs an den Vorstand von Brugg Regio
  • Periodische mündliche Berichterstattung und Diskussion des Projektverlauf mit der Arbeitsgruppe Gesundheit (=Projektsteuerung) von Brugg Regio
  • Meilensteine gemäss Konzept zur Pilotphase
  • Abbruch- oder Anpassungsklauseln


C. Governance

  • Die Vergabe erfolgt durch den Vorstand Brugg Regio auf Antrag der Arbeitsgruppe.
  • Brugg Regio führt die Buchhaltung für das Pilotprojekt, Budgetverantwortung beim Mandatsträger und Arbeitsgruppe.
  • Die Projektbegleitung wird durch die Arbeitsgruppe wahrgenommen.
  • In der Arbeitsgruppe ist eine Vertretung der Verwaltung, welche den Zugang zur Verwaltung der beteiligten Gemeinden sicherstellt und beratend für Verwaltungsabläufe zur Verfügung steht.
